content.text: {"findings":[{"title":"Turn on prompt caching for Claude so the long system prompt and tool list stop being billed at full price every turn","effect":["cheaper","faster"],"proof":"vendor claim","effort":"Hours","where":[{"file":"crates/aura-config/src/config.rs","line":102,"text":"prompt_caching: bool,"},{"file":"crates/aura-config/src/config.rs","line":125,"text":"prompt_caching: bool,"},{"file":"examples/reference.toml","line":234,"text":"# prompt_caching = true"},{"file":"examples/reference.toml","line":250,"text":"# prompt_caching = true"}],"why":"AURA already has a prompt_caching setting for the Anthropic and Bedrock providers. It defaults to off (the reference config says \"default: off\") and is commented out in the example config. Agents re-send the system prompt, tool list and history on every turn, and orchestrated worker agents inherit the setting, so setting prompt_caching = true under the agent's [llm] block is enough. Anthropic's listed prices put a cache read at 0.1x the input price (0.05x on Sonnet 5.5), but a write costs more than plain input. How much this saves depends on how often the prefix repeats, which the code can't show, and there is no independent measurement for this product.","options":[{"name":"Claude prompt caching (existing prompt_caching switch)","what":"Set prompt_caching = true for the Anthropic or Bedrock provider. Anthropic lists cache reads at 0.1x input price, 0.05x on Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5, with writes at 1.25x for 5 minutes or 2x for 1 hour. Prompts under the model's minimum length are silently not cached. Check cache_read_input_tokens to confirm hits.","needs":"Nothing new; flip the existing setting.
